'''Jerbhen Hulis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the war, he and his [[Unidentified Padawan (Great Galactic War)|Padawan]] were assigned by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to investigate [[Exal Kressh]], who had been providing the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] with information on the military movements of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3678 BBY]], the two searched for Kressh aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] ''[[Grace of Champalan Tides]]''.

Their search eventually led them to [[Lenico IV]]. While investigating the planet's surface after the orbital [[Lenico Colony Blue]] fell into its atmosphere, Hulis encountered the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]]. There, Hulis convinced Kel to aid him in rescuing the surviving colonists on the planet's surface. Shortly after helping Hulis, Kel found Hulis' Padawan and killed him.

==Behind the scenes==
The last name "Hulis" was the family name of [[Noab Hulis]], another Miraluka Jedi Master around the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. This was also the maiden name of his daughter [[Krynda Draay|Krynda]] who later took her [[Barrison Draay|husband's]] last name.
